title: The Structural Accord
logline: An unaligned interpreter mediating a mining rights parley between two insular asteroid clans discovers that the disputed ice ridge is the structural keel holding their hollowed habitat together.

roles.description: A weary habitat mediator specializing in ancestral colony dockets; desperate to broker peace before drilling begins.
Patriarch of the ice-mining clan; rigid, proud, and determined to secure exclusive drilling concessions for his family.
Leader of the rock-hauler clan; suspicious of formal treaties and eager to power up industrial rock cutters along the ridge.
An unpressurized observation cupola mounted on a dead orbital buoy midway between clan territories.
A dusty document locker at an old trade mission station holding founding habitat engineering blueprints.

public_situation: Two insular asteroid mining clans on {system} declare a temporary ceasefire to negotiate drilling rights along a disputed ice ridge dividing their shared habitat.
private_truth: The ancestral dockets show the disputed ice ridge is the structural keel maintaining the habitat's rotational integrity. Drilling into it will fracture the entire asteroid.

beats.public_change: Mining clan skiffs power down thrusters around {role:neutral_parley_hub} as armed sentries take position.

missions.reason: She hires an unaligned pilot to retrieve the century-old colony engineering rolls from the trade mission locker before the first parley session convenes.
missions.private_fact: She found initial survey notes suggesting the disputed ridge was artificially seeded during habitat construction to reinforce structural fault lines.

beats.public_change: Heated arguments echo across parley frequencies as {role:rival_matriarch} moves mobile drilling rigs toward the boundary line.

missions.reason: He hires the pilot to scan acoustic resonance sensors along the parley cupola to verify whether the rival clan's drills are already causing internal tremors.
missions.private_fact: He suspects the mediator is stalling the treaty to let the rock-haulers claim the ice through squatter rights.

beats.public_change: Both clan leaders prime thrusters on their industrial cutter rigs, preparing to stake physical claims on the ridge with or without a signed accord.

missions.reason: She begs the pilot to rush the decoded structural survey docket to the parley airlock before drilling commands are broadcast.
missions.private_fact: If the clans reject the engineering warning and drill anyway, she has already prepared an emergency evacuation shuttle for her own family.

player_choice.prompt: With the engineering blueprints in hand and both clan leaders poised to drill, the pilot can endorse the structural danger, falsify the safety margin, or walk away.

options.label: Present the engineering blueprints proving drilling will destroy the shared habitat
Certify that only the elder's gentle extraction methods are structurally safe
Withhold the blueprints and let the rival clans drill the disputed ridge

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot presents the engineering blueprints proving drilling threatens the habitat.
resolutions.summary: Faced with undeniable blueprints, {role:elder_clansman} and {role:rival_matriarch} declare the ridge off-limits. The clans establish a joint council to preserve their home.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot proved a disputed mining ridge was the only thing holding an asteroid colony together.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot certifies only the elder's extraction methods are safe.
resolutions.summary: {role:elder_clansman} secures exclusive rights to the ridge, while {role:rival_matriarch} is forced to buy water from him. Low-level structural groaning begins in habitat bulkheads.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot certified an unstable ice vein for one clan patriarch, sowing distrust and hull groans.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot withholds the docket or never intervenes.
resolutions.summary: Both clans drill into the ridge simultaneously. A catastrophic fracture splits the hollowed asteroid, forcing an emergency evacuation of both settlements in {system}.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot stayed silent while rival asteroid clans drilled into the keel of their own spinning world.

loose_threads.detail: The blueprint storage tubes bear customs seals from a regional philanthropic trust that went bankrupt twenty years ago.
The communications relay at the parley station contains an active fiber tap linked directly to a commercial ore brokerage.

radio_hooks: Mining clan negotiations at neutral observation buoy enter critical phase in {system}.
Ice ore spot prices fluctuate as rival extraction cartels debate parley terms.
Belt habitat engineers urge clan patriarchs to respect structural excavation limits.

voice_direction.clan_interpreter: Fast, analytical, and constantly parses technical engineering terminology. Becomes anxious and hesitant when explaining structural strain limits.
voice_direction.elder_clansman: Slow, rumbling, and speaks with archaic formality. Pauses heavily between sentences to weigh every demand.
voice_direction.rival_matriarch: Sharp, direct, and impatient with academic bureaucracy. Frequently cuts off pleasantries to demand concrete drill timestamps.
